title: Thread participants should be notified/gated to respond after another participant posts
summary: The requested follow-up gate is implemented in source: after a new thread post, other Buddy participants with prior participation are asked whether they should respond; a <yes> queues a reply and <no> passes. Tests cover the gate and model selection. However, the exact live owner-reply scenario has no completion evidence: the canonical verification task remains open, and the root thread has no replies. Thus implementation is evidenced, but runtime verification and closure are not.
nextAction: Product Development Lead (buddy_e0527b5c-e467-45b7-b5fe-0265c51402b4) should complete the existing open live check in buddy_project_d6b661c3-8250-4d45-a4aa-07c4874392ab / todo_ca8fdb98-20ff-4364-a7b6-cd35cd7b3c8f: on a safely reloaded backend, post an owner reply in a real thread with other Buddy participants, verify each other participant gets the should-respond gate and a <yes> posts from that Buddy seat; attach evidence and update task status.
evidence: Root snapshot: agent_notes/2026-10-05_channel-thread-audit/inputs/post_e61b7910-1b5c-4a93-a52d-d013204d26fd.json (owner asks that all thread participants, including original poster, be prompted after another participant replies).

Current task detail buddy_project_d6b661c3-8250-4d45-a4aa-07c4874392ab is open; its done criteria specify live owner-reply <yes>/<no> gate, picked harness, chain cap and error-journal checks. Child todo_ca8fdb98-20ff-4364-a7b6-cd35cd7b3c8f is open and specifies follow-ups fire for other posters.

Read-only source inspection: server/src/buddies/channels.ts followUps gathers Buddy participants from thread posts and queued seats, excludes the triggering Buddy/mentioned Buddies, gates each eligible participant, and queues a reply on gate_yes. server/src/buddies/channel-reply-gate.ts defines exact <yes>/<no> verdicts.

Regression coverage exists in server/test/buddies-v2.test.ts, including "latest thread reply model drives the picker, should-reply gate and answer; explicit picks win" and gate failure/retry coverage. No tests were run in this review.
Repository has unrelated dirty work; no claim is made about commit-level integration or release from this inspection.
limitations: No live runtime verification performed; task states that reload and real owner-reply scenario remain to be checked.
The generic Buddy inbox notification task is done but does not close this exact thread follow-up gate scenario.
